decisions.change: Prioritize returning only red shoes, visibly keep the jacket, and leave starting, approval, and completion to the host.

Separate requested preferences from observed source values. Explain that the printed-label path requires a printer and the observed QR transition changed the destination to store credit; expose mismatches with Restore my choices.

Render fees, refund amounts, options, and checks from runtime data. Keep unknowns explicit and provide only choice, validation, and restoration actions; never equate a saved draft with a completed return.

Generate informational reached-state cards from supplied discovery flows and screens, with observed fallbacks. Prioritize the help route, describe incomplete exploration, and disclose the changed product-page evidence rather than implying a verified transaction.

Use a warm cream canvas, forest text, restrained green accents, labeled native selects, visible keyboard focus, responsive columns, and live status messaging. Avoid reproducing reported low-contrast source styling.
